basic_details.job_title: NIT Puducherry Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of ECE at National Institute of Technology Puducherry, Karaikal, is recruiting 2 Project Associate-I for the ISRO-funded project "Design and Development of Intelligent Frequency Selective Surface (IFSS) for Satellite Application" under the ISRO-RESPOND project. The emoluments are Rs. 31,000 + 10 % HRA. The essential qualification is a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology (Branch: ECE/CSE), and Indian Nationals only may apply. Applications are accepted only on the portal www.nitpy.ac.in on or before 27 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Apply only through the online application portal www.nitpy.ac.in for the Project Associate-I position.
Submit the application on or before 27-11-2026.
Do not send any hardcopy; the notice says so in capital letters.
Be ready to produce original certificates and relevant documents at the time of the interview / selection process.
The notice gives the Principal Investigator's e-mail as [email protected] beneath the signature.
important_instructions: Candidates must ensure, before appearing for the selection process, that they are eligible for the position they apply for. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview / selection process. Canvassing in any form leads to rejection of the candidature. NIT Puducherry does not bear any implications/obligations on the recruited project associate in a given project. Selected candidates will not be permitted to claim any regular / part-time appointment in this institute or any other during this period.

content_sections.heading: About NIT Puducherry
content_sections.text: The notice describes National Institute of Technology Puducherry as an Institute of National Importance under MoE, Govt. of India, located at Thiruvettakudy, Karaikal - 609 609. The post sits in a research project run under the Principal Investigator, Dr. R. Boopathi Rani, Associate Professor, Department of ECE.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The total is 2 vacancies. The notice prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian Nationals only. The essential qualification and the desired qualification printed in the notice are below. Desired qualification and skills: Master's Degree in ECE/CSE is preferable. Preference will be given to those who have experience in Microwave Engineering and AI/ML. Previous working experience in R&D or related research projects. Age limit: the notice prints the age limit as 35 (years). It prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent (Branch: ECE/CSE)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs. 31,000 + 10 % HRA. The project runs for 01 Year and 06 Months. The advertised post lasts till November 2027 and can be extended further for a period of 06 months, subject to performance and availability of funds. The tenure of the Project Associate-I is co-terminus with the project. The notice also mentions an opportunity for doing Ph.D at NIT Puducherry as per Institute Norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Puducherry PROJECT ASSOCIATE-I
content_sections.text: Apply only through the online application portal www.nitpy.ac.in for the Project Associate-I position. Submit the application on or before 27-11-2026. Do not send any hardcopy; the notice says so in capital letters. Be ready to produce original certificates and relevant documents at the time of the interview / selection process. The notice gives the Principal Investigator's e-mail as [email protected] beneath the signature.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be intimated about the selection process through e-mail or phone. Original certificates and relevant documents are verified at the time of the interview / selection process. The decision of the selection committee is final. The notice prints no date or venue for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must ensure, before appearing for the selection process, that they are eligible for the position they apply for. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview / selection process. Canvassing in any form leads to rejection of the candidature. NIT Puducherry does not bear any implications/obligations on the recruited project associate in a given project. Selected candidates will not be permitted to claim any regular / part-time appointment in this institute or any other during this period.

faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent (Branch: ECE/CSE) is essential. A Master's Degree in ECE/CSE is preferable.
